title: Editor E5 slice: mount the responsive inspector on the canvas
detail:
Split from PROG-E5 on 2026-11-14. The responsive inspector model (lib/builder/inspector-model.ts) had no UI. This slice mounts it on the staff, EDITOR_CANVAS-gated /pages/canvas: fields derived on the server from the Banner block contract, the frame's device switcher, per-field provenance, a per-field reset to desktop, a bottom sheet below lg, a container-query form, and 44px targets with no hover dependency. Dark.

Closed 2026-11-14: components/builder/inspector/responsive-inspector.tsx, lib/builder/inspector-fields.ts, mounted by components/builder/canvas/collab-canvas.tsx and fed by app/(main)/pages/canvas/page.tsx. Unit tests render the provenance and reset UI. Persistence, the builder shells and real-viewport touch verification stay on PROG-E5.

verify.note: Fails on main: no inspector component and the canvas mounts none. Passes once the canvas mounts the contract-derived inspector with provenance, reset, a bottom sheet and a container query.
